svg.text: seg7_ctrl — how the 8-digit display is driven
Only one digit is ON at a time. The module scans digit 0 → 7 every 2 ms (500 Hz), so your eye sees all 8 lit.
rst_n = 0 (async, active-low): div_cnt = 0, idx = 0, an = 8'hFF, seg = 7'h7F, dp = 1 → every digit and segment OFF (blank display). All outputs are active-low: 0 = ON.
Which bits go to which digit
digits[idx*4 +: 4] = 4 bits starting at bit idx*4. idx = 3 → digits[15:12] → shows "3".
All 8 digits share the same seg[6:0] and dp pins; an[] decides which digit listens.
8 × 250 µs = 2 ms per cycle → 500 Hz: too fast to see flicker. (seg shown for digits = 32'h7654_3210)
